journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.abstract_en: This paper provides evidence showing that people are more prone to engage in nasty behavior, malevolently causing financial harm to other people at own costs, when they make decisions in a group context rather than when making choices individually on their own. We establish this behavioral regularity in a series of large-scale experiments among university students, adolescents, and nationally representative samples of adults—more than ten thousand subjects in total. We test several potential mechanisms, and the results suggest that individual nasty inclinations are systematically more likely to affect behavior when decisions are made under the “cover” of a group, that is, in a group decision-context that creates a perception of diffused responsibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供的证据表明，与个人单独决策相比，人们在群体情境中决策时更倾向于从事恶意行为，即以自身成本恶意地给他人造成经济损失。我们通过一系列大规模实验确立了这一行为规律，实验对象包括大学生、青少年以及具有全国代表性的成人样本——总计超过一万名受试者。我们测试了几种可能的机制，结果表明，当决策在群体的“掩护”下进行时，即群体决策情境造成责任分散的感知时，个体的恶意倾向更有可能系统地影响行为。

articles.title_en: The Gender Gap in Earnings Losses After Job Displacement
articles.title_cn: 失业后收入损失的性别差距
articles.abstract_en: We compare men and women who are displaced from similar jobs by applying an event study design combined with propensity score matching and reweighting to administrative data from Germany. After a mass layoff, women’s earnings losses are about 35% higher than men’s, with the gap persisting 5 years after displacement. This is partly explained by women taking up more part-time employment, but even women’s full-time wage losses are almost 50% higher than men’s. Parenthood magnifies the gender gap sharply. Finally, displaced women spend less time on job search and apply for lower-paid jobs, highlighting the importance of labor supply decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将事件研究设计与倾向得分匹配和重新加权相结合，应用于德国的行政数据，比较了从类似工作中被解雇的男性和女性。在大规模裁员后，女性的收入损失比男性高出约35%，这一差距在失业后5年仍然存在。这部分是由于女性从事更多的兼职工作，但即使是女性的全职工资损失也比男性高出近50%。为人父母显著放大了性别差距。最后，被解雇的女性在求职上花费的时间更少，并且申请薪资较低的工作，凸显了劳动力供给决策的重要性。

articles.abstract_en: We build a dynamic model where the economy is vulnerable to belief-driven slow-moving debt crises at intermediate debt levels, and rollover crises at both low and high debt levels. Vis-à-vis the threat of slow-moving crises, countercyclical deficits generally welfare-dominate debt reduction policies. In a recession, optimizing governments only deleverage if debt is close to the threshold below which belief-driven slow-moving crises can no longer occur. The welfare benefits from deleveraging instead dominate if governments are concerned with losing market access even at low debt levels. Long bond maturities may fully eliminate belief-driven rollover crises but not slow-moving ones.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个动态模型，在该模型中，经济在中等债务水平下容易受到信念驱动的慢速债务危机的影响，而在低债务和高债务水平下则容易受到展期危机的影响。面对慢速危机的威胁，逆周期赤字通常在福利上优于债务削减政策。在经济衰退中，优化政府只有在债务接近阈值以下时才会去杠杆，低于该阈值信念驱动的慢速危机不再可能发生。如果政府担心即使在低债务水平下也会失去市场准入，那么去杠杆化的福利收益则占主导地位。长期债券期限可能完全消除信念驱动的展期危机，但不能消除慢速危机。

articles.title_en: Reconstructing Income Inequality in Italy: New Evidence and Tax System Implications from Distributional National Accounts
articles.title_cn: 重构意大利收入不平等：来自分配国民账户的新证据与税收制度启示
articles.abstract_en: This work reconstructs novel series on income distribution in Italy combining survey data, tax data, and National Accounts both at the national and regional levels, and it analyzes the overall progressivity of the tax system. Our new Distributional National Accounts allow to correct for remarkable misreporting of capital income in surveys, to provide more accurate estimates of consumption, and to better account for the role of informal economy. Our fresh estimates show higher income concentration at the top 1% and 0.1% with respect to previous studies in order of 1.5 percentage points. Moreover, the share of national income of the richest top 10%, top 1%, and top 0.1% has been steadily increasing after the 2008 crisis. Our results shed further light on the multifaceted nature of inequality in Italy: youngest individuals, women, and inhabitants of Southern regions have been increasingly exposed to growing levels of inequality. Finally, the Italian tax system is only slightly progressive up to the 95th percentile of the income distribution, and regressive for the top 5%. Moreover, it is regressive throughout the whole distribution when individuals are ranked with respect to their net wealth.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究结合调查数据、税收数据和国民账户，在国家及地区层面重构了意大利收入分配的新序列，并分析了税收制度的整体累进性。我们的新分配国民账户能够修正调查中资本收入的显著漏报，提供更准确的消费估计，并更好地考虑非正规经济的作用。我们的新估计显示，与以往研究相比，顶层1%和0.1%的收入集中度更高，高出约1.5个百分点。此外，最富有的前10%、前1%和前0.1%的国民收入份额在2008年危机后持续上升。我们的结果进一步揭示了意大利不平等的多面性：最年轻的个体、女性和南部地区居民日益面临不断加剧的不平等。最后，意大利税收制度在收入分配的第95百分位之前仅略微累进，而对顶层5%则是累退的。此外，当个体按净财富排序时，税收制度在整个分配中都是累退的。

articles.abstract_en: We examine how the erosion of morals, norms, and norm compliance in markets depends on the market power of individual traders. Previously studied markets allow traders to exchange at most one unit and provide market power to individual traders by de-activating two forces: (i) the replacement logic, whereby immoral trading is justified by the belief that others would trade otherwise and (ii) market selection, by which the least moral trader determines aggregate quantities. In an experiment, we compare single-unit to (more common) multi-unit markets, which may activate these forces. Multi-unit markets, in contrast to single-unit markets, lead to a complete erosion of morals. This is associated primarily with a deterioration in norm compliance: the observed level of immoral trade is in contrast with the prevailing social norm. The replacement logic is the main mechanism driving this finding.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了市场中道德、规范及规范遵守的侵蚀如何取决于个体交易者的市场力量。以往研究的市场允许交易者最多交换一个单位，并通过削弱两种力量为个体交易者提供市场力量：（i）替代逻辑，即不道德交易被合理化，认为其他人也会如此交易；（ii）市场选择，即最不道德的交易者决定总交易量。在一项实验中，我们将单一单位市场与（更常见的）多单位市场进行比较，后者可能激活这些力量。与单一单位市场相比，多单位市场导致道德完全侵蚀。这主要与规范遵守的恶化相关：观察到的不道德交易水平与主流社会规范相悖。替代逻辑是推动这一发现的主要机制。

articles.title_en: Social Conflict and the Evolution of Unequal Conventions
articles.title_cn: 社会冲突与不平等惯例的演化
articles.abstract_en: We propose a theory of social norms (or conventions) that implement substantial levels of inequality between men and women, ethnic groups, and classes and that persist over long periods of time despite being inefficient and not supported by formal institutions. Consistent with historical cases, we extend the standard asymmetric stochastic evolutionary game model to allow subpopulation sizes to differ and idiosyncratic rejection of a status quo convention to be intentional to some degree (rather than purely random as in the standard evolutionary models). In this setting, if idiosyncratic play is sufficiently intentional and the subordinate class is sufficiently large relative to the elite, then risk-dominated conventions that are both more unequal and inefficient relative to alternative conventions will be stochastically stable and may persist for long periods. We show that the same is true in a general bipartite network of the population if most of the subordinate groups interactions are local, while the elite is more “cosmopolitan”. We apply the model to the evolution of wage conventions on the bipartite network of workers and employers, and find that an unequal monopsonistic wage convention is robust to the idiosyncratic play of workers that otherwise might displace it.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种社会规范（或惯例）理论，该理论实现了男女之间、族群之间以及阶级之间实质性不平等，并且尽管这些规范低效且不受正式制度支持，却长期持续存在。与历史案例一致，我们扩展了标准的不对称随机演化博弈模型，允许子群体规模不同，并允许对现状惯例的异质性拒绝在某种程度上是有意的（而非标准演化模型中的纯粹随机）。在这种设定下，如果异质性行为足够有意，且从属阶级相对于精英阶层足够庞大，那么相对于替代惯例而言，既更不平等又低效的风险主导惯例将是随机稳定的，并可能长期持续。我们证明，在总体的一般二部网络中，如果大多数从属群体的互动是局部的，而精英更为“世界主义”，则同样成立。我们将该模型应用于工人与雇主二部网络上工资惯例的演化，发现不平等的买方垄断工资惯例对工人的异质性行为具有稳健性，否则这些行为可能会取代它。

articles.title_en: The Incentive Complementarity Between Formal and Informal Enforcement
articles.title_cn: 正式与非正式执行之间的激励互补性
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a model in which people exchange some goods and services informally in their community and others formally on a market. We show that enforcement by informal communities and a formal market are complements: If communities ostracize individuals who are caught cheating on the market, this bolsters incentives to comply with exchanges in both settings. Although transactions within a community generate lower gains from trade than those on the wider market, the enhanced incentives from simultaneously transacting in communities and on the overall market can be welfare-enhancing compared with either extreme. We discuss the implications of informal community exchanges in a country’s development as well as how moral or religious beliefs enhance the complementarity between community and formal enforcement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个模型，在该模型中，人们在社区内非正式地交换某些商品和服务，而在市场上正式地交换其他商品和服务。我们表明，非正式社区和正式市场的执行是互补的：如果社区排斥那些在市场上被抓住作弊的个人，这会增强在两个环境中遵守交换的激励。尽管社区内的交易比更广泛市场上的交易产生的贸易收益更低，但同时在社区和整体市场上进行交易所增强的激励，与任一极端情况相比，都可能提高福利。我们讨论了非正式社区交换对国家发展的影响，以及道德或宗教信仰如何增强社区与正式执行之间的互补性。

articles.title_en: Policies or Prejudices? An Analysis of Antisemitic and Anti-Israel Views on Social Media and Social Surveys
articles.title_cn: 政策还是偏见？社交媒体与社会调查中反犹与反以色列观点的分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the extent to which personal biases affect political views, in the context of how antisemitism influences opinions about Israel. Two empirical analyses are conducted. The first one analyzes social media chatter about Jews and Israel in the UK, revealing a strong, positive relationship between negative chatter about both of them at the daily-location level. In order to establish causality, social media chatter about a “Jewish” football team in the English Premier League (Tottenham) is used as an instrument for negative expressions about Jewish people to explain negativity toward Israel. The second empirical analysis uses the 2016 wave of the German Social Survey, which reveals a strong and robust relationship between several commonly used measures of antisemitic beliefs and holding anti-Israel views. A causal interpretation of this finding is supported by an IV analysis motivated by Voigtländer and Voth who show that Nazi indoctrination during the WWII period had a lifelong impact on antisemitic views. In both analyses, the IV estimates are considerably larger than OLS coefficients.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察个人偏见在多大程度上影响政治观点，具体背景是反犹主义如何影响对以色列的看法。进行了两项实证分析。第一项分析英国社交媒体上关于犹太人和以色列的讨论，揭示了在日-地点层面上，关于两者的负面讨论之间存在强烈的正相关关系。为了建立因果关系，使用社交媒体上关于英格兰足球超级联赛中一支“犹太”足球队（托特纳姆）的讨论作为对犹太人负面表达的工具变量，以解释对以色列的负面态度。第二项实证分析使用2016年德国社会调查的数据，揭示了几个常用的反犹信念测量指标与持有反以色列观点之间存在强烈且稳健的关系。这一发现的因果解释得到了由Voigtländer和Voth启发的工具变量分析的支持，他们表明二战期间纳粹灌输对反犹观点产生了终身影响。在两项分析中，工具变量估计值均显著大于普通最小二乘系数。

articles.title_en: Cardinal Sins? Conspicuous Consumption, Cardinal Status and Inequality
articles.title_cn: 原罪？炫耀性消费、基数地位与不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the social dilemma arising when a large population of individuals with differing incomes have concerns over relative deprivation in terms of visible or conspicuous consumption. These relative concerns are cardinal—people care about the size of the gap between own and others’ consumption—and include inequity aversion, where negative comparisons are more important than positive, rivalrous preferences, and comparison with mean consumption. The resulting Nash equilibrium is inefficient, with consumption generally exceeding the socially efficient level. In this model, the income distribution has a direct effect on behavior and under rivalrous preferences, an increase in incomes for the rich can raise consumption at all income levels and make almost everyone worse off.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了当大量收入不同的个体对可见或炫耀性消费的相对剥夺感产生担忧时所出现的社会困境。这些相对关注是基数性的——人们关心自己与他人消费之间差距的大小——并且包括不公平厌恶（其中负面比较比正面比较更重要）、竞争性偏好以及与平均消费的比较。由此产生的纳什均衡是低效的，消费通常超过社会有效水平。在该模型中，收入分配对行为有直接影响，在竞争性偏好下，富人收入的增加可以提高所有收入水平的消费，并使几乎所有人的境况变差。

articles.title_en: Agency in Hierarchies: Middle Managers and Performance Evaluations
articles.title_cn: 层级中的代理问题：中层管理者与绩效评估
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal joint design of incentives and performance rating scales in a principal-manager-worker hierarchy. The principal wants to motivate the worker to exert unobservable effort at the minimum feasible cost. Given the worker’s effort, two signals are realized: public and verifiable output and a private non-verifiable signal known only to the manager. The principal may try to elicit the manager’s private information by requiring her to evaluate the worker’s performance. Payments may depend on output and the manager’s evaluation. I show that the principal can achieve no more than what is feasible with a binary rating scale. I also identify scenarios where subjective evaluations are valuable (non-valuable), reduced transparency is advantageous, and forced ranking outperforms individual evaluations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在委托人-管理者-工人层级中激励与绩效评级量表的联合最优设计。委托人希望以最低可行成本激励工人付出不可观测的努力。给定工人的努力，两个信号得以实现：公开且可验证的产出，以及仅管理者知晓的私人不可验证信号。委托人可以通过要求管理者评估工人绩效来尝试获取管理者的私人信息。支付可能取决于产出和管理者的评估。我表明，委托人所能实现的最优结果不超过二元评级量表所能达到的水平。我还识别了主观评估有价值（无价值）、降低透明度有利以及强制排名优于个体评估的情景。
